scope: Controlled CLI ODBC key-update and null-merge comparison in one default Station instance. The K02.var01 source is flattened from two named Station instances into one unnamed instance without changing business rows, then imported as a positive control. A task-local Access MDB Station row matches BASE-01, changes DESCR, and leaves QTY and TYPE null.

manual.rule: Database import into an existing input document merges on key and an empty imported field does not erase an existing value; CLI -import DSN followed by -save writes the result.

frozen_commands: native import/export/calculate/report of the default-Station baseline
create and x86 ODBC-readback one task-local Station MDB with null QTY/TYPE
create and verify an exact temporary 64-bit user DSN, import its row into the baseline SXI, then remove the DSN
native JSON-export/calculate/report of the merged SXI
compare merged model rows, event log and quantitative report against the baseline and accepted K02
acceptance_hypotheses: The native baseline converter has zero errors, valid SXI/SXO and one default Station instance holding exactly BASE-01 and K02-NAMED business rows.
The MDB has only its authored Station row and true database nulls for QTY and TYPE.
ODBC import updates BASE-01 in the same default Station instance, changing only DESCR; QTY=1 and TYPE=WS remain, and no duplicate BASE-01 appears.
The merged model converts with zero errors and valid SXO, with mission events and quantitative results equal to the baseline in this fixed teaching model.
The temporary DSN is absent after import and at closure; GUI PID/start/session and MDB association remain intact.
gate: Publish only after exact row and native event/result comparison pass in a separate read-only replay. A changed business field other than DESCR, duplicate key, converter rejection, invalid SXO, or stale DSN excludes this candidate.
limitations: The earlier named-Station v1.0.0 probe inserted the ODBC row into the default instance and yielded converter #2013 against K02-BASE; its sealed local diagnostic closure is 5d696cd7bf7e3a823cd76b7511fe76628bde9b1950862837cf4cd04d8e4b96e4. It is excluded from this acceptance.

This tests one default-instance Station key, one task-local MDB and the installed Access driver. Named-instance merge, aliases, sorting, invalid values, new-key append, ODBC report output, GUI and general K05 remain unverified.
